items.title: 'You won't make it back': Trump's threat to Iran reps at peace talks
items.description: Donald Trump warns the Iranian delegation they might not return home from talks in Switzerland as the US and Iran argue over the fate of the Strait of Hormuz.

items.title: 2.7 tonnes of cocaine found in elaborate bunker system at Sydney property
items.description: A record 2.7 tonnes of cocaine worth an estimated street value of $816 million has been seized at a semi-rural property in Greater Western Sydney.

items.title: Tax system favours older Australians over younger, report finds
items.description: Australia's tax policy settings are leading to vastly different outcomes for people who have the same gross incomes but are simply different ages, a new report shows.

items.title: Live: Australia signs 'biggest' export deal with Canada for $2.5b radar
items.description: Australia has signed its biggest-ever defence export deal, with Canada purchasing surveillance radar technology in a $2.5b agreement. Follow live.

items.title: Gus Lamont's grandmother denies involvement in disappearance
items.description: One of the grandmothers of missing four-year-old Gus Lamont says police have a theory that she buried her grandson after an accident — an allegation she describes as "ludicrous".

items.title: Live: Egypt pulls ahead of New Zealand in crucial World Cup clash
items.description: Cabo Verde held Uruguay to a stunning 2-2 draw in Miami to give the World Cup minnows another memorable, magical moment, as New Zealand takes on Egypt. Follow live.

items.title: Victoria ended native forest logging. So where are these trees coming from?
items.description: Four Corners follows the logs, and the money, to uncover how efforts to end logging have shifted the timber trade across state borders.

items.title: Live: WiseTech Global shares slump more than 10pc
items.description: Australian stocks edge up while global markets remain on edge as US-Iran peace talks falter. Shares in WiseTech Global plunge more than 10 per cent in early trade. Follow the day's events and insights from our business reporters on the ABC News live markets blog.

items.title: Black swan 'wipe-out' predicted as dead birds reported along WA coast
items.description: More than a dozen dead birds that washed up on southern WA beaches are reported to authorities amid concerns an outbreak of avian influenza is spreading.

items.title: Potential students allege visa scam tied to education consultancy
items.description: Aspiring students looking to study abroad in Australia say they've been left blindsided and with their futures in doubt after an education consultancy promised them migration and visa advice.

items.title: British PM expected to resign after challenger's thumping by-election win
items.description: Less than two years after being elected in a landslide, the Labour PM is expected to announce his resignation to make way for another leader.

items.title: There's more to housing demand than population growth
items.description: The problem for both the Coalition and Labor is that things are only going to get more difficult for ordinary families in the years ahead, and the economic environment is likely to keep favouring One Nation's message.

items.title: Sydney Swan Taylor Adams announces AFL retirement
items.description: Hard-luck Sydney midfielder Taylor Adams has called time on his AFL career after a tough run with soft-tissue injuries.

items.title: Nude swimmers take chilly plunge in Dark Mofo solstice swim
items.description: Dark Mofo's Nude Solstice Swim marks the festival end of Tasmania's fortnight-long winter arts event.

items.title: History quiz: Where was Ned Kelly finally captured?
items.description: Can you answer our questions about Anna Wintour, Australian tennis royalty and the doughnuts of the past? Test yourself.

items.title: Final beanie festival a hit with crowds as $400k worth of caps sold
items.description: The 30th and final Alice Springs Beanie Festival has been a sellout, setting a new record of $400,000 worth of beanies sold in three days.

items.title: 12 rising musicians advance to ABC Young Performers Awards semifinals
items.description: 12 young musicians including pianists, string players, saxophonists and more will compete in the live performance round for the ABC Young Performers Awards in August.

items.title: Green drought like 'trying to live on watermelon' for livestock
items.description: A splash of green has returned to New South Wales paddocks that were bare and barren just weeks ago, but the soil is still depleted and so are farmers' bank accounts.

items.title: Jacob Elordi, Robert Irwin, Lisa Millar and more snag 2026 Logie nominations
items.description: The annual awards show also introduced a new category honouring Australian sports journalists, named after legendary commentator Bruce McAvaney.

items.title: Signs of life in Ningaloo Reef's baby coral after damaging year
items.description: After suffering its worst bleaching event on record, only to be battered by Cyclone Narelle six months later, the World Heritage-listed reef is showing its first signs of recovery thanks to the efforts of marine scientists.

items.title: Why super will be paid at the same time as wages from next week
items.description: Many businesses support the payday superannuation changes, but some are concerned they will not be able to meet the obligations.

items.title: Think writing off something on tax makes it free? It doesn't
items.description: Advertisers tout EOFY sales as a prime time for big buys, and hint at the promise of a generous tax refund, but that's not quite how it works.

items.title: Auction clearance rates fall to lowest level in six years
items.description: Not since the early days of the COVID-19 pandemic have sellers seen such disappointing results at auction, with Cotality predicting "a further loss of momentum" in the housing market.

items.title: This dog's cancer treatment 'excited' the US health boss but humans face hurdles
items.description: Rosie the dog had her tumours treated by an mRNA vaccine developed with the help of artificial intelligence. Her owner had decided to explore treatment options using AI chatbots.

items.title: Kennedy looks for sprint double as Comm Games athletics team revealed
items.description: Australia's newly flush sprinting stocks squeeze Josh Azzopardi out of the solo events despite finishing second in the 100m at the national championships in April.
